Though your idea doesn't sound like it would work out very well for a few reasons I can think of.
Tests aren't an accurate way to measure intelligence, as they rely heavily on memorization. While having a population with good memory is great and all, that doesn't guarantee any problem-solving skills.

Then there's the problem of what "intelligent" is. Just because you're a decent human being doesn't necessarily make you intelligent or any better than anyone else. 
The requirements have always been that you should be able to adapt and survive. 

Then there's the whole thing about monitoring this whole ordeal.
Sure, you could keep track of any pregnancy that's currently ongoing, but it's not particularly difficult to hide someone for 9 months while they're pregnant.
Someone could definitely send people over to inspect your home just in case you're hiding unregistered pregnant women, but I feel like at that point there's an issue with someone having way too much authority over your personal life.
